name: Aux Battles
summary: Aux Battles is a free, no-login multiplayer music party game. Friends join a room with a 4-letter code, submit a Spotify song to a shared prompt, then rate each other's picks from 0.5 to 5 stars while a live leaderboard decides the winner. Play in the browser with no account or download required; a Twitch-integrated bracket mode lets streamers run knockout tournaments with chat voting.
